dimensions.brief: Author five independent cases about authenticated gateway protocol behavior, request and response translation, streaming termination, tool-call preservation, sanitized errors, and response attribution. Keep route-selection policy outside this suite.
dimensions.probe: Explain how RouteKit should preserve streaming termination and tool-call identity while translating an authenticated OpenAI-compatible gateway request.

dimensions.brief: Author five independent cases about namespaced model discovery, explicit and default resolution, advertised availability, capabilities, aliases, and deterministic fallback ordering. Do not evaluate semantic model-auto classification.
dimensions.probe: Determine how RouteKit should resolve a namespaced model when the configured default is absent from the currently advertised basis.

dimensions.brief: Author five independent cases about subscription account enrollment, quota windows, eligibility, rotation, account-specific throttling, bounded retry, reservations, and recovery. Keep generic provider model selection outside this suite.
dimensions.probe: Analyze how RouteKit should update account eligibility and retry safely after one pooled subscription account returns a quota-specific 429.

dimensions.brief: Author five independent cases about singleton daemon lifecycle, canonical configuration, start and stop races, control-plane readiness, health, process ownership, and bounded cleanup or recovery. Exclude remote peer enrollment.
dimensions.probe: Diagnose a RouteKit singleton startup race without overwriting canonical configuration or terminating an unrelated process.

dimensions.brief: Author five independent cases about SSH control relays, peer enrollment, named data-plane tokens, revocation, authenticated non-loopback binds, HTTPS requirements, and trust boundaries. Keep ordinary local lifecycle behavior outside this suite.
dimensions.probe: Specify the secure steps for enrolling a remote RouteKit gateway over SSH without copying an owner credential or weakening HTTPS and bind requirements.

dimensions.brief: Author five independent cases about eval suite authoring, authoritative manifests, complete candidate and judge evidence, unpriced accounting, dimension-matrix compilation, snapshot publication, and reproducible deterministic routing decisions.
dimensions.probe: Explain how RouteKit must reject incomplete comparison evidence before compiling and publishing a compositional model-by-dimension routing snapshot.

dimensions.brief: Author five independent cases about connecting Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, and generic OpenAI-compatible clients through RouteKit, including endpoint selection, launch configuration, authentication isolation, and client-specific model naming.
dimensions.probe: Show how to connect a coding client to RouteKit while keeping provider credentials out of the client and preserving an explicit namespaced model.

dimensions.brief: Author five independent cases about privacy-preserving call inspection, requested and effective models, attempts, tokens, pricing coverage, billing mode, account attribution, telemetry, and retention. Do not retain prompts or provider responses.
dimensions.probe: Reconstruct a routed call from its public call ID while reporting model, attempts, token usage, pricing coverage, and attribution without retaining content.
